# Token Usage Tracking

This migration adds columns to the `compile_runs` table to track various metrics related to LLM and embedding token usage. The newly added columns include counts for LLM calls and tokens used, which allows for more accurate cost estimation and monitoring of resource utilization during the compilation and reconciliation processes.
